title: dnaa-6 payoff — mechanistic DnaA-ATP/oriC initiation gives clean once-per-cell-cycle replication
caption: Reference operating point (n=4, K=30 nM), mechanistic oriC-low trigger, seed 1, 8 generations. TOP: cell mass sawtooths and divides every generation. MIDDLE: oriC count steps strictly 1↔2 — exactly one initiation per cycle, no re-initiation (the over-initiation to oriC→4 in the earlier build does not reproduce; F-04). BOTTOM: oriC-low DnaA-ATP occupancy fills, fires, and resets once per generation. Total cellular DnaA holds the [300,800] homeostatic band (mean 458).
interpretation: Biology-driven replication initiation (DnaA-ATP filament at oriC) now drives a clean, periodic cell cycle in place of the cell-mass heuristic: one fill→fire→reset per generation, oriC 1↔2, DnaA homeostatic. This is finding F-04 shown directly.
